# Roubler | Product Overview

Roubler is an integrated labour management, remuneration and custodial remuneration platform for shifts and hours. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
